source_title: Bihar Politics: Neeraj Kumar Takes a Dig at Lalan Singh After MLC Win, Signals JDU Rift
source_excerpt:
Fresh signs of internal discord have emerged within the Janata Dal (United) following the Bihar MLC election results, with senior leader Neeraj Kumar expressing displeasure over Union Minister Lalan Singh's failure to congratulate him on his victory. Neeraj Kumar, who won the Patna Graduate constituency for the fourth consecutive time, said that several senior leaders had called to congratulate him, including Ram Nath Thakur, Deputy Chief Ministers, working president Sanjay Jha and other party leaders. However, he pointed out that Lalan Singh had not contacted him. When asked whether he would call Lalan Singh to seek congratulations, Neeraj Kumar rejected the suggestion, saying he would rather meet party workers, whom he described as the foundation of his political career. The remarks have triggered fresh speculation about tensions within the JD(U). Neeraj Kumar also spoke openly about the difficulties he faced during the election campaign, alleging that he had endured political and mental harassment. He claimed that Anant Singh had used his full influence to defeat him and said he would repay the treatment he had received, using a remark about returning a debt with interest. Anant Singh had supported Jan Suraaj candidate Anuj Singh in the Patna Graduate contest and had reportedly expressed confidence in his victory. However, Anuj Singh finished third, according to Neeraj Kumar's account. Reflecting on his earlier electoral defeat in 2015, Neeraj Kumar said the experience had caused him deep disappointment, but he maintained that truth ultimately prevails. He also credited the party's decision under the leadership of Nishant Kumar for his latest victory. His comments have brought the spotlight back onto internal equations within the JD(U), particularly following a high-stakes election marked by factional differences.
